데이터를 고치는 일은 모두 Scripts/ProcessingScripts: Do every change to the data with scripts in Scripts/ProcessingScripts, and save the result in Data/AnalysisData
분석 스크립트가 만든 표·그림은 Output/Results에, 맨 위에는: Tables and figures from the analysis scripts go in Output/Results; the Readme and report sit at the top, and the master script that runs everything in order goes in Scripts
이 폴더를 어디에 쓰실 건가요?: What will you use this folder for?
Good for splitting all your personal documents into a few big boxes.
Good for splitting work by project.
Suits media that piles up by date.
A structure that follows reading → data → analysis → manuscript → presentation.
Suits records that pile up by date, like receipts, bills and received files.
If you're organizing for the first time, a system with few boxes is easiest.
이미 파일이 있는 폴더 정리하기: Tidy a folder that already has files
지금 폴더의 파일을 종류·날짜·스타일대로 옮깁니다 (실행 전 미리보기,: Moves the files in the current folder by type, date or style (preview first, can be undone).
마감이 있는 일이 많나요?: Do you have a lot of work with deadlines?
보고서, 이사, 신청서처럼 끝나는 날이 있는 일: Things with an end date, like reports, a move, or applications
마감 있는 일은 Projects 칸으로 나누면 끝난 뒤 보관하기 쉽습니다: Putting work with deadlines in a Projects box makes it easy to archive when it's done.
Material without an end is easy to find when numbers fix its place.
자료를 번호로 찾는 게 편한가요?: Do you like finding things by number?
\"22.04\"처럼 번호만 대면 위치가 정해지는 방식: A system where a number like "22.04" tells you the location
If you like numbering, Johnny.Decimal is the fastest.
If you find things by name, a simple system with few boxes suits you.
고객이나 거래처별로 일이 나뉘나요?: Is your work divided by client or partner?
Putting Date_Project under each client folder sorts them by start date.
다른 사람과 함께 쓰나요?: Do you share it with others?
Shared folders are less confusing with a structure that has clear rules.
Keeping originals separately in RAW stops them mixing with retouched versions.
With Date_Event folders, name order is time order.
디자인·영상·음악 작업 파일: Design, video and music working files
Splitting into originals, work, exports and reference keeps working files from mixing.
어떤 연구를 하나요?: What kind of research do you do?
문헌을 읽고 원고를 써요: I read papers and write manuscripts
Splitting into literature, data, analysis, manuscript and presentation lets you find things in the order you work.
원본 데이터와 스크립트를 나눠 두면 누구나 결과를 다시 만들 수 있습니다: Keeping original data and scripts apart means anyone can rebuild your results (TIER).
데이터 과학·머신러닝 코드를 써요: I write data science or machine learning code
data·notebooks·models로 나누는 Cookiecutter: The Cookiecutter layout of data, notebooks and models is widely used in data science.
뇌 영상(MRI·EEG·MEG)을 다뤄요: I work with brain imaging (MRI, EEG, MEG)
If brain imaging data follows the BIDS standard, analysis tools can read it right away.
정리할 자료가 많은 편인가요?: Do you have a lot to organize?
With lots of material, fixing places with numbers keeps you from getting lost.
With a moderate amount, four boxes are enough.
